caption: The drawing depicts a figurine of a man and a dog seated on a green base. The man, positioned on the left, has light brown skin, exaggerated facial features, and is wearing a gray helmet with a black band and a black coat. His pants are yellow, and he is wearing red vertically striped trousers over yellow pants, with black shoes. The man is smiling and has visible sideburns and a prominent nose. Seated on the man’s lap is a dog with a light gray coat featuring dark spots, a curled tail, and a pink mouth with visible teeth and a pointed tongue. The dog’s legs and toes are yellow. The man is holding the dog around its body with his left hand, and both are resting on a rectangular green base with a leafy texture. The background is a plain beige color. The artist’s signature, “Christ Markreno,” is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Toy Bank: Paddy and the Pig
